cases.economic_identity: Borzești Energy Storage SRL at Bacău/Onești Romania, RNV Infrastructure–Greenvolt Power joint vehicle, Renovatio Solar integrated EPC, CATL technological battery partner; 918MWh pre-COD project.

execution_credibility_gate.reason: Renovatio Solar's first-party post and distributed management statements explicitly identify its integrated EPC role with CATL, project 918MWh and Greenvolt owner; construction start is secondary-reported, not verified completed.

independent_cardability_gate.reason: Site-specific named EPC/technology partnership is materially different from Full's other Romania/CEE ESS cases; 918MWh is planned project energy capacity, not delivered battery volume or operating revenue.

decision_value.denominator_gap: No defensible existing Romanian energy-storage installed capacity denominator used; project nameplate 918MWh is not market share.
decision_value.judgment: Named greenfield EPC responsibility is concrete project progression, but commissioning and purchase-volume transfer remain prospective.

publication_urgency.reason: Expected 12-month delivery schedule after announcement; verify on-site milestones and procurement orders without assuming finish.

date_role.date_basis: Romanian press-released management statements and trade coverage from 2026-09-17

before_after.changed_judgment: Specific technology/EPC project execution path now identified, not plant operational or 918MWh delivered.

before_after.remaining_uncertainty: Executed cell/systems purchase order quantity/price and binding terms; exact construction permits, physical work milestone, equipment dispatch, COD.
